output.delivery.sourceCapacityUnknown: Current imported-source counts or route limits are unavailable. Native generation stays blocked until these values are verified.
output.delivery.nativeCapacityExceeded: Distinct imported source files in this Document: {count}. The current native route limit is {limit}. Owned uploads and reads have their own limit. Reconfirming the plan does not change either limit.
output.delivery.sourceChecksUnknown: Current source checks are unknown. Refresh outputs to obtain their status.
output.delivery.sourceChecksUnavailable: Current source access, rights, or evidence checks did not complete. Resolve the reported issues; refreshing only rechecks their status.
output.delivery.deliveryScopeUnavailable: The complete delivery state could not be verified. Refresh to recheck its records and evidence. Reconfirming a plan does not repair missing evidence or capacity limits.
output.delivery.savedPlanSourcesUnverifi: Saved plan; source checks are not verified
output.delivery.sourceChecksMeaning: These checks cover current source access, rights, and evidence integrity; they do not fact-check or approve content. Authors may edit and confirm structure while uploads, file use, generation, and delivery remain blocked.
output.delivery.sourceRouteLimit: Limit for distinct imported source files: {count}
output.delivery.sourceDistinctUnknown: The distinct source total is unknown; it is not assumed to be zero.
output.delivery.sourceLimitsMeaning: Route limits describe bounded evidence checks, not source removal or permission to use a file. Current source checks and the route’s own preflight must still pass.
output.delivery.sourceNamesUnknown: The authorized source-name list is incomplete or contains shortened names.
output.delivery.sourceNamesIncomplete: The source-name list is incomplete or contains shortened names. {count} reference names are not shown.
output.delivery.sourceReadinessUnknown: Source checks are unavailable; delivery readiness is unknown.
output.delivery.uploadRevisionNotRefresh: A newer authorized revision could not be verified. Your selected file is retained; no upload or revision change was attempted.
output.delivery.releaseChanged: The source, exact file, or package plan changed. Refresh and request the current file or package again.
output.delivery.uploadRevisionConflict: The saved Document revision changed before this upload. Your selected file is retained; refresh and review the current source before restaging it.
output.delivery.uploadAuthorityChanged: The upload’s source or authorization checks changed. Your selected file is retained; recheck current access and source evidence before restaging it.
output.delivery.uploadFileRetained: Your selected file is retained. Resolve the reported issue before uploading again. Changing the revision alone does not resolve capacity, rights, evidence, or inspection failures.
output.delivery.recheckUpload: Refresh checks before restaging this file
output.delivery.operationTimeLimit: This native attempt reached its execution time limit, including planning and repairs. A request already sent may still incur charges. No replacement is submitted automatically.
output.delivery.receiptUncertainHeld: Provider acceptance or cost is unresolved. The spending reservation stays held; do not authorize a replacement while this remains unknown.
output.delivery.receiptCheckExplanation: Check saved receipt uses only evidence already stored by Forma. It does not contact a provider, generate work, release an unknown charge, or alter the required output.
output.delivery.receiptActorOnly: Only the person who authorized this attempt can check its saved receipt. An authorized operator can investigate using the technical receipt below.
output.delivery.receiptStillActive: This attempt is still active. Check its saved receipt after it stops; no replacement is authorized by this control.
output.delivery.receiptEscalation: If the saved receipt still cannot establish acceptance or cost, give the technical receipt to a Forma operator or your workspace administrator. Ask them to investigate the existing attempt before considering a release or replacement. This interface has no self-service override for an unknown charge.
output.delivery.operationReceiptPrivacy: This receipt contains technical identifiers and recorded accounting, not source text or generation inputs. Copying does not send it anywhere; share it only with an authorized operator.
output.delivery.operationReceiptUnavaila: A complete technical receipt is unavailable in this scope. Refresh before copying identifiers.
output.delivery.operationReceiptCopied: Technical receipt copied. It was not sent to anyone. Share it only with an authorized Forma operator or workspace administrator.
output.delivery.operationReceiptCopyFail: Automatic copying was unavailable. Select the technical receipt below and copy it manually.
output.delivery.operationReceiptAccessCh: The operation receipt is no longer available in this scope. No result from the previous scope was shown.
output.delivery.operationReceiptCheckFai: The receipt check could not be confirmed. No new provider request was submitted. Refresh the saved state or give the technical receipt to an authorized operator.
output.delivery.operationReceiptRefreshF: The saved receipt was checked, but current Output state could not be loaded. Refresh before acting; no new provider request was submitted.
output.delivery.operationReceiptStillUnk: The original receipt check could not establish provider acceptance or cost. Review the refreshed operation and accounting for the current state. If acceptance or cost remains unknown, do not submit a replacement; copy the technical receipt and ask an authorized operator to investigate.
output.delivery.operationReceiptKnown: Persisted provider evidence was reconciled. No provider request was sent. Review the updated operation and spending before considering further work.
output.delivery.operationReceiptNoChange: The saved receipt needs no further financial reconciliation. No provider request was sent and no new work was started.
